params.body:
Context for the handover could be added on every node, but nothing said where to start, what mattered most, or how far along the table was. Overdracht only gathered what had already been told.

## Te bespreken

A list at the top of Overdracht, to work down at the table:

- **Most important first, in three tiers**, each row saying why it is on the list:
  1. **Eerst:** relations only the owner carries or marked of high importance, and the ten largest clients by revenue share in the last full year.
  2. **Dan:** the ten largest suppliers by purchase share, the 15 busiest active projects and the 15 people with the most site days, both over the last three months.
  3. **Tot slot:** the 10 most used machines over the last three months.

  A node in several tiers appears once, in its highest tier, with all its reasons ("Enkel Geert draagt ze, hoog belang; 0,77% van de omzet in 2025").
- **Progress.** "N van M besproken" with a bar. A node counts as discussed once it has any context.
- **"Nog te doen" (default) or "Alles".** In "Alles", what has been discussed stays visible, marked.
- **Working down the list.**
  - A row opens its context panel in place, with a link to where the node opens (Netwerk or Verkennen).
  - When a note ticks off the open row, the next row still to do opens by itself.
  - **"Niets bijzonders"** ticks a row off without a story. It is stored as a note of its own kind (`niets`), counted as discussed, and left out of the gathered notes and the CSV.

## Code

- `App\Handover\Agenda` ranks the list. The ranking reads invoices and bookings, so it is cached until the next relations or reference sync (and per day). The note counts are read fresh.
- `NodeContext::nothing()` adds the "Niets bijzonders" note, offered while a node has no context yet.
- `Handover` listens to `context-saved`: it refreshes the list and opens the next open item.

## Tests

- `HandoverAgendaTest` covers:
  - the order: the owner-carried relation, then the largest clients;
  - the reasons;
  - suppliers, projects and people in tier 2, machines in tier 3;
  - "Niets bijzonders" ticks the open item off, the next opens, the progress moves, and the note stays out of the gathered notes.
- Full suite green.
- On a copy of the production-size database: 69 items, the page loads in 39 ms once the ranking is cached (252 ms the first time); tick one off and the next opens.
